reason: A DSH web client UI plugin that replaces the native model selector with a themed model picker and reasoning-effort slider, including optional animated visual effects and persisted display settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端提供带主题动画效果的模型选择器和推理强度滑块，并支持按模型能力进行强度调整。
summaries.en: A DSH web client plugin that provides a themed model picker and reasoning-effort slider with model-aware effort selection and optional animated effects.

capabilities: Replaces the DSH web conversation model selector UI
Provides reasoning-effort selection with model-specific fallback handling
Serves bundled image assets through a static host route
Persists optional UI settings in localStorage
